title: OB1: n-agentic-harnesses - Reusable Skill Pack for Agentic Harness Design and Auditing
relevance_note: A comprehensive architectural framework and skill pack for building and auditing agentic harnesses. It decomposes the harness into 11 distinct reference modules covering everything from state durability to UX/observability. Specifically rejects 'coordination theater' in favor of lean, single-agent defaults.
reason_included: Directly provides the 'how-to' for implementing the core lego blocks of the TerminalBench agentic harness.

claim_snippets.claim_text: Agentic harnesses fail in production when they treat the LLM call as the whole system and ignore the '80% plumbing' (persistence, permissions, context).
The framework prioritizes 'Harnesses over Orchestration', suggesting that a better harness for a single agent often solves problems that people try to solve with multi-agent complexity.
